title: Nearly Gorenstein and almost symmetric properties in shifted numerical semigroups
summary: Given the integers $0 0$. For sufficiently large $n$, we prove that if $M_n$ is nearly Gorenstein or almost symmetric, then so is $M_{n+r_k}$. A key ingredient is to relate the pseudo-Frobenius elements of $M_n$ and $M_{n+r_k}$, correcting a wrong claim in the literature. Moreover, we derive explicit formulas for the Frobenius and pseudo-Frobenius numbers of $M_{n+r_k}$.
